ios.desc:
Spech AI is a speech analysis and practice application that helps users improve their public speaking skills through AI-powered feedback.

Key Features (Free):
- Record and analyze your speeches in real time
- Basic analysis metrics
- Daily challenges to practice and improve
- Access to basic educational content

Premium Features (Requires Subscription):
- Advanced analysis with detailed metrics: pace, clarity, filler words, prosody
- Unlimited access to recordings and historical analysis
- Speech archetype analysis based on your results to understand your speaking style
- Personalized tips and recommendations to improve your speech
- Premium content and exclusive challenges
- Personalized smart notifications
- Priority support

Premium features require an active subscription. You can subscribe monthly or annually from within the app. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings.

---
Premium plans:

Monthly: $24.99/month
Annual: $70.99/year

Terms of Use: https://spechai.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://spechai.app/privacy
